note: Site lists 8 core vitolas. Mac folder (after light reorg - 5 loose top-level files moved in and renamed) has several limited/special releases not on the standard list. 'PerfecXion No. 4' from the Mac photo likely corresponds to the site's existing 'PerfecXion No. 4 Series X' entry - same core vitola, no separate entry added. 'Super Belicoso' matches the site's existing entry exactly, no gap.

additional_vitolas.name: Angel's Share Robusto
additional_vitolas.notes: Limited release, November 2012, commemorating Arturo Fuente's 100th anniversary; milder-profile OpusX. Dominican Chateau de la Fuente sun-grown wrapper, box-pressed, triple cap.

additional_vitolas.name: Belicoso XXX ("Belicoso xXx")
additional_vitolas.notes: Cigar Aficionado Top 25 Cigars of 2010, #3, 95 points. All-Dominican.

additional_vitolas.name: The Undefeated
additional_vitolas.size: Approximately 6 x 56 (halfwheel's estimate only - Fuente never published an official spec sheet, so treat size as unconfirmed)
additional_vitolas.notes: One-off exclusive contributed to the Cigar Rights of America (CRA) Freedom Sampler, Spring 2023 - an industry-advocacy fundraiser sampler, NOT connected to a boxer or the 'UNDEFEATED' streetwear/sneaker brand despite the name (no source supports that association). Made entirely from Dominican-grown OpusX tobacco.

additional_vitolas.name: 25th Anniversary ("25th Aniversario Tributo")
additional_vitolas.notes: Released November 2021 to mark OpusX's 25th year since its 1995 debut (release itself came slightly after the literal 25-year mark due to pandemic delays). Standard boxes plus ultra-limited Elie Bleu humidor tiers (88 units of 25 cigars at ~$9,250; 25 units of 144 cigars at ~$70,000). The Mac photo ('25th-Anniversary_Pack-Sleeve') likely depicts this release's standard packaging.

unresolved_flag.issue: Photo filename references 'Oro' (gold). Two distinct real OpusX product families use this word: (a) OpusX Rosado Oscuro Oro (a rosado-wrapper line, several vitolas), or (b) OpusX Templo de Oro (a 2023 gold-foil-wrapped mystery/limited release). Could not determine which without a visual check of the band/box art. NOT added as a vitola entry - left as an open flag for you to confirm by eye, at which point it can be researched precisely.
